title: fix(cli): os plugin publish decodes the compiled manifest once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DWfbWGe13nw95fycDvobgKZ)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxECYe6ksiqRSsT4Rm

Fixes #27914

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os plugin publish` 只解码一次插件包里的编译清单;`readCompiledPluginManifest` 在解析结果旁一并交回解码出的原始文档,发布直接上传它。
- 为什么改:原来发布要二次解码同一条目,还靠 CLI 与 runtime 两处各自拼写的文件名做非空断言查找,两边拼写一旦不同就会崩。
- 风险与回滚:无行为变化,上传内容逐键不变(不带 schema 补的默认值);回滚即撤此 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/compiled-plugin-manifest.ts` 的返回类型与 `publish.ts` 的一行替换。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/plugin-publish-manifest-entry.test.ts`(在 main 上红:TypeError)。
- 需要你做的:无;席位复核后按落地授权处理。

## What changes

- `readCompiledPluginManifest` (`@objectstack/runtime`): the `ok` arm of `CompiledPluginManifestRead` gains `document`, the manifest entry as decoded before the `ManifestSchema` parse. Nothing else in the result moves.
- `os plugin publish` (`@objectstack/cli`): `plugin_manifest` is `read.document`. The second `JSON.parse` and the non-null `archiveFiles.find(f => f.path === MANIFEST_FILENAME)!` are gone.
- Changeset: `patch` on both packages.

## Why

The publish door decoded the same entry twice and found it the second time by the CLI's own spelling of the filename, so it held only while `MANIFEST_FILENAME` (CLI) and `COMPILED_PLUGIN_MANIFEST_FILE` (runtime) spelled the same string (contract review 6514352615 on PR #27910). The verbatim upload stays verbatim: the parsed value stamps `scope` and `defaultDatasource`, which would no longer match the signed bytes.

## Verification

Pins first, measured against `main`'s source (runtime rebuilt from it):

- **Control, green on `main` and here:** `plugin-publish.test.ts` now also checks `JSON.stringify(plugin_manifest)` equals the archive entry's decoded document, key for key and in order.
- **Drift pin, red on `main`, green here:** `plugin-publish-manifest-entry.test.ts` mocks the CLI's `MANIFEST_FILENAME` to a different spelling. On `main`: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'data')` at the second lookup. Here: publish posts both requests and uploads the entry's document. Reached without a product change.
- **Runtime unit:** `compiled-plugin-manifest.test.ts` (new): `document` carries no stamped default and matches the entry key for key; red on `main` (no `document`).
- `@objectstack/cli` full suite: 535 files passed, 1 skipped (6663 tests passed, 9 skipped). Runtime: `compiled-plugin-manifest` + `installed-plugin-loader` suites, 61 passed. `tsc --noEmit` clean on both packages.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 61 families derived, 60 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, prerequisite). `--ran` reconcile: 0 UNRUN. `pnpm lint`: exit 0.

Out of scope, noted only: the integrity preflight's `exempt` list in `publish.ts` is still spelled with the CLI's `MANIFEST_FILENAME`, so the same two-spelling dependency remains there (the drift pin uses a manifest with no `integrity` map for that reason).

Skills-docs: none. `grep -rn "readCompiledPluginManifest\|CompiledPluginManifestRead\|plugin_manifest"` over `skills/`, `content/docs/`, `docs/` (`.md`/`.mdx`): 0 hits. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json` names `readCompiledPluginManifest` and says the uploaded `plugin_manifest` stays the artifact's own manifest, which still holds.

Clause-②: yes (widening: the `ok` arm of `@objectstack/runtime`'s exported `CompiledPluginManifestRead` gains `document`; every existing key keeps its value)
Metadata-protocol: none
